vibe_rationale: Curated indie line-up with a city-week side programme, but a mass-scale festival format with global headliners and bank-led ticketing.
fit_notes: Adult indie and alternative music fans, with weak wellness adjacency. One listed bank partner (BBVA) and a partnership page with a contact email, and tiers beyond BBVA are not announced. The city-week side events may offer smaller, more community-feeling activation slots than the main site. Argentina-based.
